query:
with ov as (
 select order_id, sum(unit_price * quantity * (1 - discount)) as value
 from `northwind-demo-512222.northwind.order_details` group by order_id
), o as (
 select c.country, coalesce(ov.value, 0) as value
 from `northwind-demo-512222.northwind.orders` o
 join `northwind-demo-512222.northwind.customers` c using(customer_id)
 left join ov using(order_id)
 where o.order_date between date '1900-01-01' and date '2999-12-31'
), p as (
 select country, percentile_cont(value, 0.75) over(partition by country) as f,
 percentile_cont(value, numeric '0.75') over(partition by country) as d from o
)
select distinct country, typeof(f) float_type, typeof(d) decimal_type,
format('%.17g',f) float_raw, cast(d as string) decimal_raw,
format('%.2f',round(f,2)) float_display, cast(round(d,2) as string) decimal_display
from p where country in ('USA','Switzerland') order by country
